title: sporobolus ramulosus
intro: Sporobolus ramulosus, commonly known as Bushy Spike-grass or Bushy Beard-grass, is a type of grass native to Australia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving wound healing. The plant is said to have therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Sporobolus ramulosus include saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
